policies.name: Land Reform
policies.description: Redistribute land to peasants. Feeds the country and angers those who owned it.

policies.name: State Industry Expansion
policies.description: Nationalise the commanding heights. Factories get cheaper; the men who ran them leave.

policies.name: Worker Rights Act
policies.description: Unions, hours, safety. A healthier country and a dearer conscript.

policies.name: Progressive Wealth Tax
policies.description: Tax the rich heavily. Pays for the state; capital finds other countries.

policies.name: Total War Economy
policies.description: Every factory to the front. Nothing is built that does not shoot.

policies.name: Economic Deregulation
policies.description: Get the state out of the way. Building is cheap; nobody is watching.

policies.name: Privatisation
policies.description: Sell the state's holdings. A windfall, then somebody else owns the mines.

policies.name: Flat Tax
policies.description: One rate for everyone. Simple, popular with those who have most.

policies.name: Consumer Economy
policies.description: Build for the people who live here. They are happier, and there are fewer shells.

policies.name: Free Trade
policies.description: Open the ports. Wealth arrives by sea, and so does everything else.

policies.name: National Unity Act
policies.description: One nation, one story. The line holds; nobody says otherwise.

policies.name: Press Censorship
policies.description: Nothing is printed that was not approved. Quiet, and blind.

policies.name: Universal Conscription
policies.description: Every man of age. The army is enormous and the fields are empty.

policies.name: Secret Police
policies.description: They know before you do. Nothing organises twice.

policies.name: Autarky
policies.description: Need nobody. Everything is made here, badly, and cannot be blockaded away.

policies.name: Mass Mobilisation
policies.description: The whole country under arms. It cannot be kept up for long.

policies.name: Minority Rights Charter
policies.description: Rights written down and meant. The country grows and argues.

policies.name: Open Borders
policies.description: Anyone may come. They bring their hands and their grievances.

policies.name: Free Press
policies.description: Print it. The government finds out what it is doing wrong, publicly.

policies.name: Decentralisation
policies.description: Let the provinces decide. They build faster and answer slower.

policies.name: General Amnesty
policies.description: Let them come home. The prisons empty and so does the grievance.

policies.name: Professional Army
policies.description: Fewer soldiers, and every one of them meant it. Expensive.

policies.name: Naval Supremacy
policies.description: The fleet first, and the army with what is left.

policies.name: Continental Army
policies.description: Land wars are won by armies. The fleet can wait.

policies.name: Colonial Office
policies.description: Govern the empire from one desk. Efficient, and resented.

policies.name: Commonwealth Settlement
policies.description: Partners, not possessions. Slower, and it holds.

policies.name: Technocracy
policies.description: Rule by those who can do the arithmetic. Nobody voted for them.

policies.name: Traditionalism
policies.description: The old ways, kept. The country is calm and does not change.

policies.name: Patriotic Education
policies.description: A campaign. The next generation is taught who they are.

policies.name: Opposition Smear Campaign
policies.description: A campaign. Whoever was gaining is now explaining.

policies.name: Industrial Rationalisation
policies.description: Merge the works, close the worst, standardise the rest. Efficient, and somebody's town dies.

policies.name: Full Employment Guarantee
policies.description: Everyone works, whether or not the work is needed. Nobody starves and nothing is cheap.

policies.name: National Infrastructure Programme
policies.description: Roads, rail, wire. Everything afterwards is cheaper; the bill arrives first.

policies.name: Agrarian Priority
policies.description: The countryside first. The nation eats well and builds slowly.

policies.name: Naval Supremacy Doctrine
policies.description: The fleet is the country's shield and its budget. The army waits.

policies.name: Continental Army Doctrine
policies.description: Wars are won by men on ground. The admirals are told to economise.

policies.name: Merchant Marine Act
policies.description: Subsidise the hulls that carry cargo. They carry troops too, when asked.

policies.name: Total Mobilisation Economy
policies.description: Everything the country has, aimed at the front. There is no going back cheaply.

policies.name: Consumer Goods Priority
policies.description: Butter, not guns. The country is content and slow to anger.

policies.name: Demobilisation
policies.description: Send them home. The barracks empty and the fields fill.

policies.name: Veterans' Settlement
policies.description: Land for those who served. Loyal country, and the ledger notices.

policies.name: Universal Healthcare
policies.description: Care at the point of need. A bigger, healthier, more expensive nation.

policies.name: Austerity Programme
policies.description: Cut until the books balance. They balance.

policies.name: Civil Service Reform
policies.description: Examinations, not connections. Slow to bed in, and then it simply works.

policies.name: Martial Law
policies.description: The army governs. Order is immediate and it is remembered.
